purpose: Explicit behaviour-over-time reference modes for RMD. This registry defines the empirical targets that later endogenous feedback structure must explain; it does not activate any behavioural mechanism.

modes.role: Observed forcing in early monetary-transmission validation; later endogenization requires a separately validated monetary-policy reaction function.
modes.source: BIS / BNR policy-rate series retained by validation recovery

modes.role: Reference mode for household monetary pass-through.
modes.source: ECB MIR household housing new-business RON rate

modes.role: Reference mode for NFC monetary pass-through.
modes.source: ECB MIR NFC new-business RON rate, including short-fixation target used in validation recovery

modes.role: Observed monthly private non-financial credit stock reference mode: end-of-period ECB BSI loan stocks for domestic NFCs (S.11) plus households/NPISH (S.14/S.15), MFIs excluding the NCB, all currencies combined.
modes.source: ECB BSI exact S.11 and S.14/S.15 end-of-period loan-stock series for Romania; retained compact snapshot with immutable workflow provenance.

modes.role: Observed monthly private non-financial credit-flow reference mode: ECB BSI financial transactions for domestic NFCs (S.11) plus households/NPISH (S.14/S.15). It is not a first difference of the loan stock and not gross new-lending originations.
modes.source: ECB BSI exact S.11 and S.14/S.15 financial-transaction series for Romania; retained compact snapshot with immutable workflow provenance.

modes.role: Observed quarterly behaviour-over-time reference mode for consolidated general-government gross Maastricht debt at nominal/face value; distinct from market-valued financial-accounts liabilities and holder-by-issuer Accounting Spine stocks.
modes.source: Eurostat gov_10q_ggdebt, Romania S13 GD; retained MIO_NAC and PC_GDP source snapshot with immutable audit provenance.

modes.role: Observed quarterly ESA general-government interest-expenditure reference mode for the interest-cost leg of government dynamics; it is not an effective interest rate, marginal yield, cash-interest measure, or refinancing-share estimate.
modes.source: Eurostat gov_10q_ggnfa, Romania S13 D41PAY, NSA; retained MIO_NAC and PC_GDP source snapshot with immutable audit provenance.

modes.role: Observed annual government-debt refinancing/liquidity-pressure reference mode using the Ministry of Finance principal-repayment/refinancing component. It is explicitly distinct from gross financing need, pre-financing, maturity/refixing shares and matched repricing events.
modes.source: Romania Ministry of Finance annual/monthly public-debt reports and completed-year execution sources; retained continuous 2013-2024 observed history under a frozen revision-precedence contract.

modes.role: Observed annual year-end Ministry of Finance government-debt portfolio average interest-rate reference target. The source metric is a portfolio cost indicator and is not Eurostat apparent cost, a marginal sovereign yield, or an inferred repricing rate.
modes.source: Romania Ministry of Finance government debt-management strategies; retained 2014-2023 annual series and explicit source provenance.

modes.role: Partial sectoral-financial-position reference boundary. The original holder-by-issuer multi-instrument state remains governed by Accounting Readiness. A narrower aggregate behaviour-over-time boundary is scientifically admissible in principle; Phase A failed exact component coverage and Phase B recovered complete total-F/F1 source coverage but failed preregistered system reconciliation. No promotion is permitted.
modes.source: ECB QSA Accounting Spine and retained instrument-specific recovery artifacts; only F3 is canonically complete across stock and flow.
modes.post_run_s1n_boundary_diagnostic_effect: NONE; all eight exact S1N F/F1 stock/flow asset/liability queries returned ECB HTTP 404 with no network errors, so the diagnostic does not justify a formal boundary retest or readiness promotion.
modes.external_reopen_screening_summary: Eurostat nasq_10_f_cp is the priority discovery candidate because it explicitly disseminates quarterly financial-account counterpart information, but Eurostat metadata states the data are validated by ECB and republished, so discovery can establish public counterpart coverage—not statistical independence. OECD counterpart dataflows remain a secondary discovery path with the same lineage caution.
modes.eurostat_counterpart_discovery_probe_exe: NONE; the probe remains preregistered and manual-only. Default-branch workflow presence is an execution prerequisite, not scientific reopen evidence.

closure_rule: Integrated behavioural closure may not be declared validated until the reference modes required by each active loop have explicit observed targets or a documented reason why only qualitative/reference-pattern validation is possible.

closure_readiness_policy.rule: A required reference mode counts as ready for integrated quantitative behavioural-closure validation only when it has an observed series under a ready status, unless a future explicit contract change registers a mode-specific qualitative exception with a stated validation basis and justification. Partial, source-identified, or unresolved modes remain blockers.
